audit: Atelier 1.9 package and source inventory refresh

scope.method: Read-only CPU/file inspection; only this audit JSON is written. No builds, native app launch, GPU work, runtime tests or commits.
scope.limitations: Signature/resource integrity identifies the current package. This audit does not recompile it or establish runtime behavior. Source reconstruction proves only the exact scoped changes against the previously tested source hashes.

git.sourceState: Current nonignored working-tree snapshot, including new files; not a claim all changes are committed.

changedFiles.description: About-panel geography credit changes McCormick Place to Robie House.
Offscreen CLI do-block gains scoped ProcessInfo userInitiated activity and defer endActivity.

testedArtifactComparison.method: Compare every selected source file and mode with the tested inventory. Reverse each exact allowed edit in memory and require the complete reconstructed file SHA-256 to equal its tested source hash.
testedArtifactComparison.runtimeEquivalenceClaim: No runtime equivalence or performance conclusion: the CLI activity changes process scheduling policy. Existing GPU results retain their original executable scope.

sourceInventory.selectionMethod: Existing tracked/untracked paths under selected roots, filtered by git check-ignore --no-index. Entire docs/, root README, ignored outputs, caches and build/package directories are outside this source inventory.
